name: Stage_Events
_about: The shared event log (spec 05 / 04). The form itself (Record_Type, Record_Id, Event, Occurred_At, Reported_At, Source, Note) comes from the Fulfillment package log in zoho-export/parsed/forms; Procurement adds the fields below (record number, how exact the time is, who, and the visit number of a repeated event).

fields.name: Record_No
fields.label: Record No
fields.helpText: The number staff quote, e.g. SHP-00012.
